title: 第855章 修罗场第854章 算计
content_zh:
轰，刹那间，红光璀璨，赤霞漫天，如血染苍穹，将整座晨雾山脉映照得一片通红。山川草木皆泛赤色，连溪流都似燃起火焰，天地灵气剧烈翻涌，形成一道肉眼可见的灵潮旋涡，直冲云霄！
望见这异象，晨雾山脉四面八方，所有修士，无论是采药散修、猎妖小队，还是各宗圣子、圣女，皆忍不住抬头，脸上浮现出震惊与狂喜之色。
“灵宝出世？”
“快！锁定源头！”
“这等异象……至少是四品灵宝！”
灵宝，乃是天地自然孕育的奇珍，非人力可造。每一种灵宝诞生，必引天地共鸣，异象等级与其品质息息相关，青光为凡，白光为灵，红光为宝，紫光为圣，金光为神。
如今红光遍野，笼罩一整座山脉，虽只是最低级的灵宝，但其价值，已堪比最顶级的四品宝物！而宝物等级，与修士境界对应：一至三品，对应炼气、筑基；四品，对应金丹；五品以上，方入元婴之眼。
可即便是最低阶的灵宝，因其天生道韵、自蕴法则，连金丹巅峰乃至元婴老怪都会心动，只因灵宝可炼成本命法宝，随主人一同成长，潜力无穷！
这一刻，晨雾山脉彻底沸腾！数百道遁光冲天而起，争先恐后扑向红光中心；更有远处宗门祭出传讯玉符，急召强者驰援；连潜伏数十年的散修老魔，也撕开洞府封印，眼中贪婪如火。
然而，在人群边缘，江凡却忽然眯起了眼。他本也有一瞬炽热，毕竟，灵宝难得，若得此物，或为苍玄宗铸一件镇宗之器。
但下一瞬，他眉头微蹙，神识如网扫过天地异象：不对……这红光虽盛，却无雷劫淬体之象，亦无地脉反哺之兆。
他低声自语，这只是‘诞生’，而非‘出世’。灵宝诞生，是天地孕化完成；灵宝出世，才是破土现形、可被收取之时。两者之间，往往相隔数日乃至数月。
“看这灵潮强度与红光凝聚速度……”江凡迅速推演，“真正出世，还需两个月左右。”
他环顾四周，见无数修士已如疯狗般冲向源头，甚至开始互相攻伐，只为抢占最佳守候位置，不禁冷笑：
“一群蠢货。灵宝未出，守在旁边只会引动地脉反噬，更会引来高阶妖兽觊觎。让他们去争吧，等他们死伤殆尽，灵宝真正出世之时，才是我出手的时刻。”
他心中清楚，在争夺灵宝的过程中，最重要的从来不是谁喊得最响，而是谁跑得最快。
若拥有绝对实力，自然可镇压全场，挥手夺宝，无人敢言“不”字，但此等境界，非元婴不可为。而眼下晨雾山脉，最强不过金丹巅峰，谁敢称无敌？
因此，速度，才是真正的胜负手。拥有最快的速度，便意味着：能在灵宝破土瞬间第一个触及；能在千人围堵中撕开一道生路；能在夺宝之后，于追杀中全身而退。
而提升速度，效果最显着的，便是身法武技。身法万千，各有其道：有的如幻影迷踪，专擅惑敌；有的如游鱼穿隙，重在灵动；有的如山岳挪移，稳中藏变。
但江凡要修的，却是一门追求极致速度的身法——《九霄雷遁》。

此乃玉玄子临终前所授残篇，源自青霄大陆“雷音宗”秘传，以雷为骨，以风为翼，一步可越千丈，三步可破虚空！可惜此界灵气驳杂，雷脉残缺，他此前仅能施展第一重“踏雷步”，速度虽快，却难持久。
江凡盘坐于古树之下，神识沉入玉简。刹那间，无数雷纹涌入识海，风起于九霄，雷生于足下，身化青电，意破苍穹！
转眼间，江凡便已经在山谷内修炼了半个月。他眸中雷光一闪即逝，缓缓起身，身形微动，原地只余残影，真身已出现在数十丈之外的山巅！
他望向红光中心，眼中再无焦躁，只有冰冷的笃定：“两个月后灵宝出世，谁先触之，谁得之。而我，将快到，无人能见我出手。”
嗖嗖嗖，一道青色身影在幽深山谷中疾掠如电，快若惊鸿，每一步踏出，足下雷光炸裂，空气中留下一连串残影，如青莲绽放，层层叠叠，久久不散。
“可惜。”青色身影骤然停驻，正是江凡。他立于一块断崖之上，眉头微蹙，指尖轻抚眉心雷痕，低声自语：“虽然将这《九霄雷遁》修炼到了小成阶段，但距离中成……还是有不小的距离。”
小成之境，已可瞬移数十丈，三息之内无人能锁其踪；但中成之境，方能真正“裂空”，一步百丈，穿阵如无物，避剑于无形，夺宝于万军之中，如探囊取物。
而灵宝出世之时，必有金丹巅峰乃至半步元婴围堵，更有隐门强者暗伏。若仅凭小成身法，或许能抢得先机，却难保全身而退。
《九霄雷遁》非单纯身法，而是以雷道为基，需将自身化作“人形雷霆”，肉身、神魂、灵力三者同频共振，方能撕裂空间桎梏。
可此界雷脉残缺，天地雷意稀薄，即便他身负归墟青雷，也难以在短时间内完成质变。

离开闭关洞府，江凡向着晨雾山脉红光中心疾速奔驰。半月之期已至，天地异象愈发剧烈，赤霞翻涌如血海，灵潮旋涡直贯云霄，连百里外的山石都开始震颤崩裂。
然而，越是靠近核心，景象越是骇人。沿途所见，尸横遍野，血染林谷。
有散修伏尸于古树之下，胸口被利爪贯穿，手中仍紧攥着半张残破的遁符；有宗门天骄倒在溪边，金丹碎裂，眉心一点血洞，显然是被神识秘术所杀；更有四阶妖兽“赤瞳雷猿”与“影鳞蟒”同归于尽，巨躯纠缠，毒血腐蚀大地，草木尽枯。
断剑插在岩缝，储物袋被撕成碎片，灵符燃尽成灰……整片区域，宛如一座大型修罗场，无声诉说着这几日的惨烈厮杀。
江凡脚步未停，目光冷峻如铁，他知道，这些不过是开胃小菜，真正的杀局，还在前方。红光最盛处，已有数十道强大气息蛰伏。归墟殿、太乙、昆乾，甚至还有几股隐晦到极致的半步元婴威压……皆在等待灵宝破土的那一刻。
他掠过一具尚在抽搐的尸体，那人临死前瞪大双眼，似在望向天空，仿佛看见了什么，又仿佛……在恐惧什么。
江凡微微一顿，神识扫过四周，忽然低语：“不对……这些尸体，大多死于彼此攻伐，但地面无激烈斗法痕迹，灵力残留杂乱无章，有人在操控局势，故意驱散人群，清场。”
他望向红光中心那座孤峰，只是冷笑一声。宗门与散修仍在互相算计、彼此消耗，却不知真正的通天之路，从来不在喧嚣之处，而在寂静深渊的尽头。

content_en:
Boom, in an instant, the red light was bright, and the red clouds filled the sky, like blood staining the sky, reflecting the entire morning mist mountain range in red. The mountains, rivers, and vegetation were all glowing red, and even the streams seemed to be on fire. The spiritual energy of the heaven and earth surged violently, forming a spiritual vortex visible to the naked eye, soaring straight into the sky!
Seeing this vision, all the monks from all directions in the Chenwu Mountain Range, whether they were medicinal herb collectors, demon hunting teams, or saints and saints from various sects, could not help but raise their heads, with shock and ecstasy on their faces.
"The birth of a spiritual treasure?"
"Quick! Lock the source!"
"This kind of vision...is at least a fourth-grade spiritual treasure!"
Spiritual treasures are rare treasures naturally bred by heaven and earth and cannot be created by manpower. The birth of each spiritual treasure will surely resonate with heaven and earth, and the level of the vision is closely related to its quality. Blue light is ordinary, white light is spiritual, red light is treasure, purple light is holy, and golden light is divine.
Now the red light is everywhere, covering the entire mountain range. Although it is only the lowest level spiritual treasure, its value is comparable to the top fourth-grade treasure! The level of the treasure corresponds to the realm of the monk: the first to third levels correspond to Qi refining and foundation building; the fourth level corresponds to the golden elixir; only the fifth level and above can enter the eyes of the Nascent Soul.
But even the lowest level Lingbao, because of its innate Tao charm and self-contained laws, will make even the peak Golden elixir and even the Nascent Soul old monsters be moved. Just because the Lingbao can be made into a magic weapon of its own life, it can grow with its owner, and its potential is endless!
At this moment, the Chenwu Mountain Range was completely boiling! Hundreds of escaping lights soared into the sky, rushing towards the center of the red light; even distant sects sacrificed jade talismans to summon strong men for help; even the old devil who had been lurking for decades tore open the seal of the cave, with greed in his eyes.
However, at the edge of the crowd, Jiang Fan suddenly narrowed his eyes. He also had a moment of blazing heat. After all, spiritual treasures are rare. If you get this thing, you may forge a weapon for the Cangxuan Sect to suppress the sect.
But the next moment, he frowned slightly, and his consciousness swept through the vision of heaven and earth like a net: No... although this red light was strong, there was no sign of the thunder calamity tempering the body, nor was there any sign of the earth's veins feeding back.
He whispered to himself that this was just a 'birth', not an 'birth'. The birth of the Lingbao is the completion of the conception of heaven and earth; the birth of the Lingbao is the time when the Lingbao breaks through the earth and appears and can be collected. There are often days or even months between the two.
"Look at the intensity of this spiritual tide and the speed at which the red light condenses..." Jiang Fan quickly deduced, "It will take about two months for him to be truly born."
He looked around and saw that countless monks were rushing towards the source like mad dogs, and even started to attack each other, just to seize the best waiting position, he couldn't help but sneer:
"A bunch of idiots. The Lingbao hasn't been released yet. Staying nearby will only cause the backlash of the earth's veins, and even attract high-level monsters to covet it. Let them fight. When all their casualties are exhausted and the Lingbao is truly born, that's the time for me to take action."
He knew in his heart that in the process of competing for the Lingbao, the most important thing was never who shouted the loudest, but who ran the fastest.
If you have absolute strength, you can naturally suppress the entire crowd and seize the treasure with a wave of your hand. No one dares to say "no", but such a state cannot be achieved except by Nascent Soul. And right now, the strongest one in the Chenwu Mountain Range is only at the peak of the Golden Core. Who dares to claim to be invincible?
Therefore, speed is the real winner. Having the fastest speed means: being the first to touch the spiritual treasure when it breaks ground; being able to tear a way out when surrounded by thousands of people; being able to escape the pursuit after seizing the treasure.
The most significant effect of increasing speed is body and martial arts. There are thousands of body techniques, each with its own way: some are like phantoms, specializing in confusing the enemy; some are like fish swimming through gaps, focusing on agility; some are like mountains moving, stable and hiding changes.
But what Jiang Fan wants to practice is a movement technique that pursues extreme speed - "Nine Heavens Thunder Escape".
This is the fragment of a chapter taught by Yu Xuanzi before his death. It comes from the secret tradition of the "Leiyin Sect" in Qingxiao Continent. With thunder as bones and wind as wings, one can cross a thousand feet with one step and break through the void with three steps! Unfortunately, the spiritual energy in this world is mixed and the thunder veins are incomplete. Previously, he could only perform the first level of "Thunder Step". Although the speed was fast, it was difficult to last.Jiang Fan sat cross-legged under the ancient tree, his consciousness sinking into the jade slip. In an instant, countless thunder patterns poured into the sea of ​​consciousness, the wind rose from the sky, thunder was born under the feet, the body turned into green lightning, and the mind broke through the sky!
In the blink of an eye, Jiang Fan had been practicing in the valley for half a month. The lightning flashed in his eyes, he stood up slowly, his body moved slightly, only an afterimage remained on the spot, and his true body appeared on the top of the mountain dozens of feet away!
He looked at the center of the red light. There was no anxiety in his eyes, only cold determination: "The spirit treasure will be born in two months, whoever touches it first will get it. And I will be here soon, no one can see me take action."
Swish, swish, a green figure flew across the deep valley as fast as lightning, as fast as a giant thunder. Every step he took, thunder exploded under his feet, leaving a series of afterimages in the air, like green lotuses blooming, layer upon layer, lingering for a long time.
"What a pity." The cyan figure suddenly stopped, it was Jiang Fan. He stood on a cliff, frowning slightly, touching the thunder marks between his eyebrows with his fingertips, and murmuring to himself: "Although I have cultivated this "Nine Heavens Thunder Escape" to the stage of minor success, there is still a long way to go before it reaches the middle level..."
In the realm of Xiaocheng, one can already teleport dozens of feet, and no one can lock his trace within three breaths; but in the realm of Middle Adulthood, one can truly "split the sky", one hundred feet in a step, pass through the formation as if there is nothing, avoid the sword invisible, and seize treasures among the thousands of troops, just like picking out objects from a bag.
When the Lingbao is born, it will be surrounded by peak Jindan or even half-step Nascent Soul, and there will be even hidden sect powerhouses. If you only rely on Xiaocheng Shenfa, you may be able to seize the opportunity, but you will not be able to escape safely.
"Nine Heavens Thunder Escape" is not a simple movement method, but is based on the thunder path. You need to transform yourself into a "humanoid thunder". The body, soul, and spiritual power resonate at the same frequency in order to tear apart the shackles of space.
However, the thunder veins in this world are incomplete and the thunder energy of heaven and earth is thin. Even if he carries the Qing Lei of Return to Ruins, it will be difficult to complete the qualitative transformation in a short period of time.

After leaving the retreat cave, Jiang Fan ran quickly towards the red light center of the Chenwu Mountain Range. The half-moon period has arrived, and the strange phenomena in the heaven and earth are becoming more and more intense. The red clouds surge like a sea of ​​blood, the spiritual tide vortexes straight into the sky, and even the rocks a hundred miles away begin to tremble and crack.
However, the closer you get to the core, the more horrifying the scene becomes. Along the way, we saw corpses strewn across the fields and blood-stained forests and valleys.
There was a casual cultivator lying dead under an ancient tree, his chest pierced by sharp claws, and he still clutched half of the broken escape talisman in his hand; there was a sect prodigy who fell by the stream, with his golden elixir shattered and a bloody hole between his eyebrows, obviously killed by the secret technique of spiritual consciousness; there were also fourth-order monsters "Red Eyed Thunder Ape" and "Shadow Scale Python" who died together, their giant bodies entangled, poisonous blood corroding the earth, and the vegetation withered.
The broken sword was stuck in the crack of the rock, the storage bag was torn into pieces, and the spiritual talismans were burned to ashes... The whole area was like a large Shura field, silently telling the tragic killings of the past few days.
Jiang Fan didn't stop, his eyes were as cold as iron. He knew that these were just appetizers, and the real killing was still ahead. Where the red light is at its strongest, there are dozens of powerful auras dormant. Guixudian, Taiyi, Kunqian, and even a few extremely obscure half-step Nascent Soul pressures... are all waiting for the moment when the Lingbao breaks ground.
He passed by a body that was still twitching. Before death, the man's eyes were wide open, as if he was looking at the sky, as if he saw something, and as if... he was afraid of something.
Jiang Fan paused for a moment, then scanned the surroundings with his consciousness, and suddenly whispered: "No... most of these corpses died from fighting each other, but there are no traces of fierce fighting on the ground, and the spiritual power remains in a mess. Someone is controlling the situation, deliberately dispersing the crowd and clearing the place."
He looked at the lone peak in the center of the red light and just sneered. The sect and the casual cultivators are still scheming and consuming each other, but they don't know that the real road to heaven is never in the hustle and bustle, but at the end of the silent abyss.
